m01:room.title: The Harbor Hydrometry Shed
m01:room.job: Settle the true rate of rise at the lower quay, and the hour it reaches the deck.

m02:room.title: The Basin Forecast Workshop
m02:room.job: Settle what kind of climb the basin is on, and the hour it reaches the market road line.

m03:room.title: The Gauge Integrity Loft
m03:room.job: Settle whether the north fit's early crest is in the water or in the curve.

m04:room.title: The Sluice Calibration House
m04:room.job: Settle which Gate C settings the flow model can be trusted at, and where the hard stop belongs.

m05:room.title: The Road Control Garage
m05:room.job: Post the hour each class of vehicle loses the raised causeway.

m06:room.title: The Island Dispatch Hall
m06:room.job: Settle what kind of growth the north feeder is on, and how close to the breaker it comes by noon.

m07:room.title: The Weather Relay Block
m07:room.job: Read the growth of the pressure shortfall off the log wall, and the lift it puts on the sea by noon.

m08:room.title: The Signal Conversion Annex
m08:room.job: Turn the legacy channel's counts back into water level, and name the counts that reversal covers.

m09:room.title: The Warning Time Office
m09:room.job: Name the hour the feeder reaches its trip level, and the hour shed staging has to begin.

m10:room.title: The Tide Harmonics Hall
m10:room.job: Fix the tide's midline, swing and period, and the hour the next high water lands.

m11:room.title: The Phase Analysis Cabin
m11:room.job: Fix the window when the storm tide stands on the causeway deck.

m12:room.title: The Breakwater Model Room
m12:room.job: Settle whether the storm crest carries waves over the top of the outer breakwater.

m13:room.title: The Pilotage Chart Room
m13:room.job: Set both headings for one run out to the turbine nacelle and home again.

m14:room.title: The Lock Radar Station
m14:room.job: Settle whether the service vessel stands outside the true outflow zone.

m15:room.title: The Grid Isolation House
m15:room.job: Find the window between the vessel clearing the jet zone and the causeway flooding.
